Acceptance: DD/MM/YYYY format; daily entry | Basic record identification | | | C2 | Chainage From (km/m)
Acceptance: Start location of paving work on that day | Location tracking | | | C3 | Chainage To (km/m)
Acceptance: End location of paving work on that day | Location tracking | | | C4 | Length Paved (m)
Acceptance: Calculated as To - From; in meters | Quantity tracking | | | C5 | Width (m)
Acceptance: Paved width; typically road width | Area calculation | | | C6 | Area Paved (m²)
Acceptance: Length × Width; cumulative total in register | Area tracking | | | C7 | Layer Type (DBM/BC)

Acceptance: Aggregate nominal size of mix used | Mix specification | | | C9 | Design Thickness (mm)
Acceptance: Layer thickness per pavement design | Quality specification | | | C10 | Bitumen Grade / Source
Acceptance: 60/70, 80/100, etc. and supplier batch number | Material tracking | | | C11 | Mix Plant Temperature (°C)
Acceptance: Discharge temperature from plant; recorded per truck or hourly | Temperature control | | | C12 | Discharge Temperature (°C)
Acceptance: Temperature when material arrives at paver; should be 155-165°C | Temperature at site | | | C13 | Bitumen Quantity (kg)
Acceptance: Total bitumen used for paved area; calculated from rate | Material consumption | | | C14 | Mix Quantity (tonnes)
Acceptance: Total mix weighed from plant; from batch tickets | Material consumption | | | C15 | No. of Trucks/Batches
Acceptance: Number of loads delivered and paved on that day | Material tracking | | | C16 | Rolling Pressure / Equipment
Acceptance: Type of roller (static/vibratory), weight, no. of passes | Compaction tracking | | | C17 | Ambient Temperature (°C)
Acceptance: Air temperature at time of paving; morning, afternoon, evening | Environmental record | | | C18 | Weather Condition
Acceptance: Clear, Cloudy, Drizzle, Rain; any weather interruptions noted | Environmental record | | | C19 | Test Conducted (Y/N)
Acceptance: Y if Marshall/core tests done that day; N if not | QA activity | | | C20 | Test Result / Status
Acceptance: PASS, FAIL, or Pending; notes on any defects or concerns | QA status | | | C21 | Density Achieved (%)
Acceptance: Field density as % of Marshall density; target ≥98% | Quality metric | | | C22 | Remarks / Issues
Acceptance: Any defects, delays, material issues, contractor actions, NCRs | Documentation | | | C23 | QC Engineer Sign & Date
Acceptance: Daily sign-off by QC engineer responsible for that day | Authorization | | | B. CUMULATIVE SUMMARY ROWS | | S1 | Total Length Paved (m) — Weekly and Monthly summaries
Acceptance: Cumulative sum of daily lengths; compared to schedule | Progress tracking | | | S2 | Total Area Paved (m²) — Weekly and Monthly summaries
Acceptance: Cumulative sum of daily areas; against planned schedule | Progress tracking | | | S3 | Total Bitumen Used (tonnes) — Weekly and Monthly summaries
Acceptance: Cumulative bitumen; verified against consumption rate | Material consumption tracking | | | S4 | Total Mix Used (tonnes) — Weekly and Monthly summaries
Acceptance: Cumulative mix from plant; cross-checked with delivery notes | Material consumption tracking | | | S5 | Average Density Achieved (%) — Period summary
Acceptance: Average of all density test results for the period | Quality summary | | | S6 | Tests Conducted / Passed — Period summary
Acceptance: Total tests in period vs. tests passed; pass % calculated | QA summary | | | C. NOTES & INSTRUCTIONS | | N1 | Update register daily; entries signed by QC engineer
Acceptance: Same-day or next-day entry; no retroactive undated entries | Data integrity | | | N2 | Cross-reference to test reports and NCRs issued during period
Acceptance: NCR numbers and test report dates linked to register entries | Traceability | | | N3 | Monthly review and approval by project engineer
Acceptance: Monthly summaries approved and signed; register stamped and filed | Authorization | | | N4 | Register retained for contract duration; part of permanent project records
Acceptance: Stored in project file; protected from damage; submitted with final report | Documentation retention | | A.
